description: AM35 FPS setter (set_fps) uses RACE raceId 0x30DE. Param enabled encoded as bool at offset 6 (1=true, 0=false). RACE framing: [0x05, 0x5A, length_le_u16, raceId_le_u16, ...params]. No request checksum. Source: disassembly/AM35model.dis set_fps. Getter 0x30DF returns res[8] parsed as bool (parsers.json am35-fps). Note: AM35 FPS uses a plain bool encoding, unlike the DPI button which uses bool-lookup-u8.
